paragraphs.chinese:
这一集里，几乎每个人都在逃避一个不太舒服的真相，而每一个谎话都把事情弄得比原来更麻烦。

Phil 在 Facebook 上重新联系到了高中时期的前女友 Denise。他打算出去和她喝一杯，Claire 一听就觉得这主意糟透了。Phil 坚持说 Denise 只是老朋友，为了证明 Claire 想多了，他干脆把 Denise 请到家里来。

刚开始 Claire 甚至觉得可能真是自己太多疑。Denise 很友好，看起来完全正常。可 Claire 一离开房间，Denise 马上开始勾搭 Phil，不但提到自己的酒店，还直接塞给他一张房卡。Phil 这才终于意识到，Claire 对这个局面的判断比自己准多了。

事情很快又变得更糟。Claire 找到一张旧照片，照片里 Phil 的胳膊打着石膏，这说明 Phil 开始和 Claire 约会的时候，其实还没有完全和 Denise 分手。Denise 一直以为 Phil 是先结束了他们的关系，后来才认识 Claire。两个女人这才一起发现中间有重叠，Denise 气得直接走人。

与此同时，Manny 因为学校话剧没拿到自己想演的角色，本来就已经很低落。Jay 为了鼓励他，买了一张励志海报挂在 Manny 的宠物乌龟 Shel 上方。结果海报掉下来，直接把乌龟砸死了。

Jay 慌了。他没有告诉 Manny，而是现场编出了一整套“浣熊闯进房间”的假案发现场。他破坏窗纱、留下假脚印，还给 Manny 讲了个自己试图救 Shel 的精彩故事。Gloria 一眼就看穿了，让他赶紧坦白。

Jay 不肯，因为这种事他以前干过。很多年前，他不小心害死过 Mitchell 的一只宠物，当时选择了说实话，结果 Mitchell 到今天都还记得。Jay 于是决定，这次也许一个好一点的谎言反而更善良。

到了 Shel 的葬礼，Manny 发现自己房间里留了一袋打开的薯片，突然开始怪自己。他觉得一定是食物把浣熊引了进来。Gloria 一直给 Jay 机会让他说实话，Jay 却还是开不了口，甚至直接告诉 Manny：“Shel 原谅你了。”

当天晚上，Manny 一直没睡，专门等 Jay 回来，然后直接问：“真的有浣熊吗？”Jay 终于承认是自己不小心害死了 Shel。他说自己和 Manny 最近关系才刚刚变好，实在害怕真相会把这一切毁掉。

Mitchell 也终于不想再逃避另一件事。他的工作不停把他从 Cameron 和 Lily 身边叫走，他已经错过了不少重要时刻。老板又一次要求他在家庭时间回去上班时，Mitchell 终于说了不。老板告诉他，那就别再回来，于是 Mitchell 真辞职了。

大概有几分钟，Mitchell 觉得自己又自由又勇敢。等他回到家，突然想到房贷和孩子，马上就彻底慌了。Cameron 还是支持他，告诉他两个人总能想办法。

这一集里的真话都不太好听，但最后大家发现，藏着它反而更糟。
paragraphs.english:
This episode is full of people trying to avoid an uncomfortable truth, and every lie makes the situation harder than it needed to be.

Phil has reconnected with Denise, an old high school girlfriend, on Facebook. He plans to meet her for a drink, and Claire immediately thinks that’s a terrible idea. Phil insists Denise is just an old friend, so to prove Claire is being paranoid, he invites Denise to the house instead.

At first, Claire starts thinking she may have judged Denise unfairly. Denise is friendly and seems completely normal. Then Claire leaves the room. Denise immediately starts flirting with Phil, tells him about her hotel, and gives him a room key. Phil finally realizes Claire saw the situation much more clearly than he did.

Things get worse when Claire finds an old photo. Phil has a broken arm in the picture, which means he was still dating Denise after he had already started dating Claire. Denise had always believed Phil ended their relationship first. Now both women discover there was an overlap, and Denise storms out furious.

Meanwhile, Manny is upset because he didn’t get the part he wanted in a school play. Jay tries to cheer him up with a motivational poster and hangs it above Manny’s pet turtle, Shel. The poster falls and kills the turtle.

Jay panics. Instead of telling Manny, he creates a fake crime scene about a raccoon breaking into the room. He damages the window screen, leaves fake footprints, and gives Manny a dramatic story about trying to save Shel. Gloria sees through it immediately and tells him to confess.

Jay refuses because he has done this before. Years ago, he accidentally killed one of Mitchell’s pets and told the truth, and Mitchell never forgot it. Jay decides a good lie may be kinder this time.

At Shel’s funeral, Manny notices an open bag of chips he left in the room and suddenly blames himself. He thinks the food attracted the raccoon. Gloria gives Jay every chance to tell the truth, but Jay still can’t do it. He actually tells Manny that Shel forgives him.

That night, Manny waits up for Jay and asks directly if it really was a raccoon. Jay finally admits he killed Shel by accident. He says their relationship had only recently gotten better, and he was afraid the truth would ruin it.

Mitchell is also tired of avoiding something. His job keeps pulling him away from Cameron and Lily, and he has already missed several important moments. When his boss orders him to work on another family day, Mitchell finally says no. His boss tells him not to come back, so Mitchell quits.

For a few minutes, Mitchell feels free and brave. Then he gets home, remembers they have a mortgage and a baby, and completely panics. Cameron still backs him and says they’ll figure it out.

The truth is uncomfortable in every story here, but hiding it turns out to be much worse.
